faq.q: Why Vite instead of Create React App?
faq.a: CRA is deprecated. Vite is faster, actively maintained, and the default for React projects.

faq.q: Can I use this with Next.js instead?
faq.a: Use the `nextjs` template for Next.js 14 App Router. This template is for SPA/Vite projects.

faq.q: Does it include state management (Redux, Zustand)?
faq.a: No — the template is unopinionated about state. Add your preferred library after generation.

faq.q: What about testing — Vitest or Jest?
faq.a: Vitest (Vite-native, faster, Jest-compatible API). Configuration in vitest.config.ts.
